LanguageData.RT_TyphoonVDV_Vehicle.label: Kamaz Typhoon-VDV
LanguageData.RT_TyphoonVDV_Vehicle.description:
Airborne MRAP vehicle (4x4) with BM-30-D remote turret featuring a 30mm 2A42 autocannon and PKTM MG. Upgradable with Kornet ATGMs and AGS-30 grenade launcher.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1, Passenger x6 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 30mm 2A42 Autocannon: 30x173mm cartridge (FMJ / HE / AP-I) - 7.62mm PKTM MG: 7.62x54mmR cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP) - (Upgrade Kornet ATGM): 9M133 "Kornet"AntiTank missile(HEAT) - (Upgrade 30mm AGS-30 AGL): 30x29mm grenade (HE / HE Time-Fuzed / HEDP / EMP / Smoke)
